description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate PostgreSQL from password-based authentication to Azure Managed Identity in both the web and worker modules
tasks.reason: Both modules connect to PostgreSQL using plaintext credentials (postgres/postgres) in application.properties. Migrating to Managed Identity eliminates hardcoded secrets and improves security posture.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the PostgreSQL connection in both the web and worker modules from password-based authentication to Azure Managed Identity for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Remove plaintext credentials (spring.datasource.username, spring.datasource.password) from application.properties in both modules. Update the datasource configuration to use token-based authentication with Managed Identity.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully migrated PostgreSQL authentication from password-based to Azure Managed Identity in both web and worker modules. Added spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency (v5.19.0 via BOM in parent pom.xml) to both modules. Removed plaintext credentials (spring.datasource.password) from application.properties in both modules. Username externalized to SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME environment variable. Passwordless auth enabled via spring.datasource.azure.passwordless-enabled=true. Build passes and all unit tests pass (1/1).
